what_it_does: SPASM accelerates sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV)—a key operation where irregular data access patterns vary wildly by input structure. Traditional accelerators designed for one matrix type fail on others. SPASM extracts local access patterns from input matrices, builds a portfolio of efficient template patterns, and encodes matrix tiles using these templates. At runtime, hardware can switch between templates per tile to handle diverse matrices while maintaining load balance across processing units.
